name: Stops
description: Organ stops for any sound: copies of what is playing an octave below, a fifth, an octave, a twelfth and two octaves above, each on its own drawbar, speaking a little after the note as pipes do.

params.name: Speak
params.description: How long the ranks take to come up to level after a note starts, as a pipe takes time to speak. Short follows the playing, long lets them bloom behind it.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Voices the ranks as a whole. Low settings round off their upper partials like stopped wooden pipes, high settings make them bright and stringy.

params.name: Swell
params.description: The shutters of the box the ranks stand in. Closing them makes all the ranks softer and duller at once and leaves the sound itself alone.

params.name: Chiff
params.description: A short breath of noise at the pitch of each rank when a note starts, the sound of wind reaching a pipe before it settles.

params.name: Detune
params.description: Puts each rank a little out of tune, each its own way, so the ranks beat slowly against the sound and against each other as real pipes do.

params.name: Sub
params.description: The drawbar for the rank an octave below what is playing, the sixteen foot. It puts a soft pedal note under every note.

params.name: Unison
params.description: The sound itself among the stops, the eight foot. Pushed in, only the added ranks are left when Mix is full.

params.name: Fifth
params.description: The drawbar for the rank a pure fifth above what is playing. It thickens single lines into open, hollow chords.

params.name: Octave
params.description: The drawbar for the rank an octave above what is playing, the four foot. It is the first stop an organ adds for clarity.

params.name: Twelfth
params.description: The drawbar for the rank an octave and a fifth above. It sits on the third harmonic, so it colours a note more than it adds one.

params.name: Fifteenth
params.description: The drawbar for the rank two octaves above, the two foot. It adds a thin silver edge on top.

params.name: Mix
params.description: How much of the organ is heard. At nothing the output is the input. Turning up brings in the ranks, and lets Unison take the sound itself away.

origin.note: Spectral rank adder on kit::Stft<4096, 1024>: each spectral peak is measured (true frequency from its phase advance) and sounded again as a Hann lobe at each drawn rank's multiple.
